objective: Measure whether bounded generic non-scripted public-state exploration collects enough real task-relevant source events before any MG28 model rollout; compare to previously qualified unchanged native learners, strong action-only explorer and random.

design.seed_lineage_scope: All current branch historical original-world prereg source contracts and separately referenced MG21/MG22/MG24 published cohorts; external unindexed/private cannot be asserted.
design.information: only original 7x7x3 public image, direction, literal mission, own previously selected action and actual returned public after/reward/terminal; no map/inventory/target stage/goal oracle
design.within_family_cold_memory: retain own selected evidence from first to second and third seed; no cross-family or cross-arm history
design.generic_explorer: tabular original public exact context, own selected (action, next public state digest) history. deterministic UCB explore over all 7 actions using prior novelty of discovered successors and own state-action attempts; never consult specific object, color, mission target, or route.
design.strong_action_only: generic action-level previous source-observed next full public state-change frequency plus deterministic UCB exploration, no mission/context state.
design.random: deterministic independent Python random uniformly selects action 0..6

exact_public_outcome_types.target: selected action 3, before front original mission-colored target object 5/6/7, after front empty type 1, unchanged heading
exact_public_outcome_types.door: selected action 5, original front object4 color unchanged, state2 locked to state0 open
exact_public_outcome_types.goal: original positive terminal reward only; do not infer inventory
